themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, including complex analysis, discovery, and interaction with research environments.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Content focusing on the development, comparison, and application of various AI-powered tools designed to assist in research processes across different domains.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Discussions around AI tools that aid in writing, reviewing, and understanding code, impacting software development workflows and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is affecting jobs, recruitment, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to the creation and use of simulated users or personas for testing, research, and interaction purposes.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, benchmark, or critically assess the performance and usability of different AI tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used in the process of designing user interfaces, experiences, and products, including generative design and UX workflow optimization.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Content related to AI's capability to analyze and interpret user sentiment from reviews, social media, and other feedback channels.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discussions on how AI can automate, enhance, or be the subject of usability testing for products and services.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
